messages:
Leah M: Heads-up  GatewayX reported theyre receiving demo leads from our EU marketplace and expect to own outreach. Who takes point?

Omar S: Our playbook says marketplace leads default to BizDev/SDR for initial contact; SI supports technical discovery on request. GatewayX seems to be claiming entitlement for introduced accounts.

Priya R: Confirm these are marketplace demo requests (listing -> request demo) not partner-referral uploads? That affects entitlement rules.

Leah M: Confirmed demo requests with partner tagged = GatewayX.

Jordan (SI Ops): Per GatewayX MSA they can run technical discovery but Redwood must control contract routing. Proposed rule: if ARR < 250k EUR -> SI leads initial POC; else Redwood SDR qualifies first.

Kevin BD: Also add a 48h SLA: BizDev/SDR must attempt outreach within 48h of lead creation or partner may claim. Keeps leads warm.

Priya R: Ill start a Confluence mapping grid: region, partner, ARR_threshold, default_owner, exceptions. Will seed EU/APAC.

Omar S: Add risk flags (NDA_needed, data_residency, on_prem_hw). Mark GatewayX as on_prem_hw. Include partner_claim_proof_url for disputes.

Leah M: For joint announcements require a 2-week prep window + product sign-off; strategic enterprise exceptions must get PM+BizDev signoff.

Jordan (SI Ops): Routing pseudo-code idea: marketplace_lead && partner_tagged -> assign BizDev_primary; if no outreach in 48h -> partner_allowed_to_claim; if account_ARR < partner_threshold -> assign SI_field_team; if ARR within 20% of threshold -> route to #partnerships-triage for manual review.

Kevin BD: Require timestamped proof (screenshot of marketplace lead card) when partner claims. That should reduce disputes.

Priya R: Will include intake template, sample screenshot, CSV/JSON export sample, and webhook payload example on the Confluence page.

Omar S: Audit column: claim_proof_url + freeform "how_verified". CS to cc partner rep on initial outreach when partner claims.

Leah M: Action items: Priya  Confluence page + template by Friday; Jordan  update SI Ops playbook; Kevin  loop Legal re GatewayX MSA carveouts; Omar  add risk taxonomy and audit fields. Ill create #partnerships-triage and invite this group. :thumbsup:

announce-bot: Reminder  Partnership sync tomorrow 10:00am PT - https://cal.redwood/integrations

Leah M: Run as a 30-day pilot. Aim to make the Confluence schema machine-readable for future automation.

Jordan (SI Ops): Add contested-claim escalation: partnership ops review -> Legal arbitration for high-ARR accounts.

Omar S: Backfill last 30 days of marketplace leads to detect recurrence.

Kevin BD: Ill contact GatewayX legal today.

Leah M: Thanks team, closing loop.
